blocker_glossary.NO_QC_PASS_PET_OUTPUTS: No PET preprocessing outputs passed spatial QC gates.
blocker_glossary.PREPROCESS_NOT_EXECUTED: Method Y PET spatial preprocessing / cache build has not been executed.
blocker_glossary.PRIMARY_TIER_MIN_CLASS_BELOW_BLOCK_THRES: Primary-tier Method Y split has insufficient minority-class support for stable training.
blocker_glossary.PRIVATE_MANIFEST_NOT_TRAINING_READY: Hash-level private PET manifest is incomplete or not validated for one-PET-per-patient discipline.
blocker_glossary.REGEX_FALLBACK_MANIFEST_NOT_TRAINING_REA: PET file manifest still relies on regex fallback; training-grade private manifest is required.

claim_boundary: Exploratory PET-assisted branch (Method Y). PET never enters Method X-Strict or Method X-Cog. Multimodal PET/MRI training has not started; only design, inventory, and readiness audits exist.
execution_gates_before_training: Create separate Method Y PET preprocessing root outside Method X caches.
Create no-PET-in-Method-X regression test after adding PET code.
Confirm PET images are never loaded by Method X or Method X-Cog dataloaders.
Define whether the target is biomarker abnormality or an independent clinical diagnosis.
If clinical AD output is desired, build and validate a separate clinical-label table before training.
Keep public outputs aggregate-only unless a separate privacy review approves hash-level artifacts.
required_before_training: MRI-only baseline on Method Y split plan frozen
resolution_checklist: Build and validate private PET manifest (no regex fallback).
Execute Method Y PET spatial preprocessing and pass QC gates.
Build PET volume cache separate from Method X T1 cache.
Confirm patient-level split with one amyloid PET per patient.
Run cohort/tracer/gap confounding audits on Method Y split plan.

warning_glossary.COHORT_LABEL_AUDIT_POSSIBLE_STRONG_COUPL: Amyloid label may remain coupled to cohort/tracer in Method Y splits.
warning_glossary.GAP_LABEL_AUDIT_POSSIBLE_STRONG_COUPLING: PET–T1 temporal gap bins may correlate with label.
warning_glossary.PET_CACHE_NOT_BUILT_YET: Method Y PET volume cache has not been built.
warning_glossary.TRACER_LABEL_AUDIT_SINGLE_ROW_OR_COLUMN_: Tracer vs label contingency needs manual review.
